description: Get full details of a B2B order by ID or order number. Returns the order with branch, company, zone, assigned worker, details (waste items), and receipt if any. Requires worker JWT (Authorize).

parameters.paramDescription: (optional if order_number is provided) The unique identifier of the B2B order. Either orderID or order_number is required.
(optional if orderID is provided) The display order number (e.g. B1, B33). Either orderID or order_number is required.

branch.address: Noterdam Dpsion, Fleming, El Raml 2, Alexandria Governorate 5450203

responseDescription: Full B2B order entity with branch, company, b2b_zone, assigned_worker, created_by, cancelled_by, details (waste items), and receipt. 404 if order not found.

description: Mark a B2B order as picked up (collected). Worker submits waste details (categories, weights, optional images/descriptions). Order must be in 'ordered' status and not cancelled. Branch cycle is incremented and receipt processing may be triggered. Requires worker JWT (Authorize).

parameters.paramDescription: The unique identifier of the B2B order. Either orderID or order_number is required.
The display order number (e.g. B1, B33). Either orderID or order_number is required.
Date/time when the pickup occurred (ISO or parseable date string)
List of waste items collected. Each object: category (waste type name), weight (number, in kg), image (optional), description (optional)

responseDescription: Confirmation object with message, totalWeight (sum of all detail weights in kg), and orderID. Order status is set to 'pickedup', pickup_date is set to nowDate, and branch current_cycle_count is incremented. Returns 406 if order already collected or cancelled.

description: Get the worker's current active WasteBag for today (status = HOLDING). A new bag is created automatically when the worker marks an order as picked up. If the worker has handed over their bag and started a new one, this returns the most recent HOLDING bag.

parameters.paramDescription: The Worker ID, taken from the Authorization token

responseDescription: Returns the current active (HOLDING) WasteBag for today with all waste items and linked orders. Each bag_item includes collected_weight (from worker pickups), warehouse_received_weight (null until warehouse records it), and difference (collected minus received, null if not yet recorded). Returns 404 if no active bag exists today.

description: Get the worker's full WasteBag history, newest first. Returns all bags the worker has ever had, including handed-over ones.

parameters.paramDescription: The Worker ID, taken from the Authorization token
Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.
Number of bags per page. Defaults to 20.

responseDescription: Returns a paginated array of WasteBag objects ordered by creation date descending. Each bag includes its items and linked orders. Difference per item is null if warehouse_received_weight has not been recorded yet.

description: Get a specific worker's WasteBag(s). Behaviour depends on the query params provided: if bagID is given it returns that specific bag; if date is given it returns all bags for that worker on that date (array); if neither is given it returns the worker's current active HOLDING bag for today. Requires Worker read permission.

parameters.paramDescription: The ID of the worker whose bag(s) to fetch
The specific bag ID to fetch. When provided, returns a single bag object regardless of date.
Return all bags for this worker on the given date. Returns an array.

responseDescription: Returns a single WasteBag object (or array when date param is used) with waste items (including difference), linked orders, and worker info. Returns 404 if no matching bag is found.

description: Get all workers' WasteBags for today. Optionally filter by status. Requires Worker read permission.

parameters.paramDescription: Filter bags by status. If omitted, returns all bags for today regardless of status.

responseDescription: Returns an array of all WasteBags for today across all workers, ordered by creation date descending. Each bag includes the worker info, waste items with difference, and linked orders.

description: Record the warehouse-received weight for each waste type in a WasteBag. After this is saved, the difference (collected minus received) becomes visible per waste type. Does not change the bag status — the handover status endpoint will be added with the warehouse module. Requires Worker write permission.

parameters.paramDescription: The ID of the WasteBag to update
Array of objects, each with waste_type (string) and warehouse_received_weight (number in kg). Only waste types already in the bag can be updated.

responseDescription: Returns the updated WasteBag with all items reflecting the newly saved warehouse_received_weight values and the computed difference per item. Returns 404 if the bag is not found.

description: Get all warehouses assigned to the authenticated worker
responseDescription: Returns an array of warehouses the worker is assigned to. Each warehouse includes location info and contact details.

description: Worker initiates handover of their active bag to a specific warehouse. Bag status changes from HOLDING to PENDING_HANDOVER.

parameters.paramDescription: The ID of the bag to hand over (must be in HOLDING status and belong to the worker)
The ID of the warehouse to deliver to

responseDescription: Returns 'Done' on success. Returns 406 if bag is not in HOLDING status. Returns 404 if bag or warehouse is not found.

description: Worker confirms the warehouse weights after the warehouse has recorded them. Bag status changes from CONFIRMING to HANDED_OVER.

parameters.paramDescription: The ID of the bag to confirm (must be in CONFIRMING status and belong to the worker)

responseDescription: Returns 'Done' on success. Returns 406 if bag is not in CONFIRMING status. Returns 404 if bag is not found.

description: Worker refuses the warehouse weights. A HandoverTicket (reason: WORKER_REFUSED) is created. Bag status reverts to HOLDING and can be taken to a different warehouse.

parameters.paramDescription: The ID of the bag to refuse (must be in CONFIRMING status and belong to the worker)
Optional. Reason for refusal

responseDescription: Returns 'Done' on success. A HandoverTicket is created linking the bag to the warehouse with reason WORKER_REFUSED. Bag warehouse_received_weight values are reset to null. Returns 406 if bag is not in CONFIRMING status.
